meta.name: CCNL per i dipendenti dalle aziende di lavorazione della foglia di tabacco secco allo stato sciolto

notes.text: SALARY MODEL: split. base_salary = minimo tabellare (4 tranches: +60 at 4A on 01/01/2025, +50 on 01/01/2026, +50 on 01/01/2027, +40 on 01/01/2028). 50/50 parametric formula verified against published Allegato A table.
CONTINGENZA: per-level amounts frozen at 01/11/1991 (Allegato B, CCNL 2021). EDR 10.33 EUR uniform for all levels (Accordo Interconfederale 31/07/1992).
SENIORITY: cadence 24 months, maximum 5 scatti. Amounts from Article 32 of the 2025 renewal. Operai amounts roughly doubled vs 2021 CCNL (4A/B: 5.68->12.00, 5: 5.42->11.00, 6: 5.16->10.00).

APPRENTICESHIP: under_classification for destinations 2, 3A, 3B, 4A, 4B (36-month, 10/12/14 periods) and level 1 (36-month, 10/10/16 periods). Destination 5 (24-month exception, Article 6) not modeled. Level 1S is not an apprenticeship destination.
ALIFOND employer contribution (1.50%) modeled from 01/07/2025 (renewal Art. 47). Pre-July-2025 ALIFOND contribution not modeled.

limitation.remediation: Model the ALIFOND employer rate in force before 1 July 2025.

notes.text: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

reviews.scope: Whole file. The values checked were not recorded.
findings: The review recorded no list of the documents it read.
Confidence set to needs_review: values to re-check.

reviews.scope: The minimi of the nine categories against Allegato A of the accordo di rinnovo of 2 July 2025.
findings: Allegato A (p. 13 of the signed scan, read by OCR and on the page image): the 36 minimi of the nine categories from January 2025 to January 2028 match the file (3°B from 1/1/2027 is printed '1420,1').
The ruleset names this source, published by UILA-UIL, a signatory: source_type contracting_party instead of estimated.
The contingenza and EDR of each category (18 rules) are not in the accordo and stay assumed.

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Articolo 33 - 13a e 14a MENSILITÀ (p. 43): "il lavoratore non in prova ha diritto a tanti dodicesimi dell’ammontare della 13a e della 14a mensilità per quanti sono i mesi interi di servizio prestati. Le frazioni di mese superiori a 15 giorni saranno calcolate come mese intero.". Added: more_than 15 (the file applied the engine default, at least 15 days).

provenance.note: Number of monthly payments read from the contract file; no clause is cited for it.
